# TRAVNY

> Canonical map of the public TRAVNY hub, services, machine-readable guides and small technical publications.

Canonical hub: https://bartek.lol/
Creator: Bartek (TRAVNY / trvny).
GitHub owner: https://github.com/trvny/ · organization: https://github.com/travnie/

## Main routes

- [Hub](https://bartek.lol/) · [Markdown](https://bartek.lol/index.md)
- [TVPI](https://bartek.lol/tv/) · [Markdown](https://bartek.lol/tv/index.md)
- [TRAVNY Lab](https://bartek.lol/lab/): experiments and live widgets
- [Papagenerator](https://bartek.lol/papagenerator/): browser-only meme and sticker editor; images stay on the device
- [Badges](https://bartek.lol/badges/): ecosystem, bot, AI and live status/counter SVG badges with copyable Markdown/HTML; catalogue JSON at `/badge/index.json`
- [Teksty](https://bartek.lol/teksty/) · [Markdown guide](https://bartek.lol/teksty/index.md): unified publication directory including CoCzyDziennik and Reactor
- [CoCzyDziennik archive](https://bartek.lol/przeglad/): dated issue permalinks; publication feed remains under Teksty
- [Tokenowy Mundial AI](https://bartek.lol/teksty/token-worldcup/): six tokenizer configurations on equivalent text in 27 languages · [English report](https://bartek.lol/teksty/token-worldcup/en/) · [dataset](https://bartek.lol/teksty/token-worldcup/dataset.json)
- [GitHubowa Kraina](https://bartek.lol/teksty/githubowa-kraina/) · interactive atlas in PL, EN, RU or ZH · [English Markdown guide](https://bartek.lol/teksty/githubowa-kraina/index.md); [structured data](https://bartek.lol/teksty/githubowa-kraina/atlas.json) · [English infrastructure map](https://bartek.lol/teksty/githubowa-kraina/universe.html)
- [Grass Mud Horse (English / Polish)](https://bartek.lol/teksty/grass-mud-horse/): one bilingual article about Chinese internet slang and censorship; switch PL / EN in-page

- [Main Atom feed](https://bartek.lol/teksty/feed.xml): articles, CoCzyDziennik issues and Reactor entries, live-aggregated

## Usage notes
- The standalone home radio supports swiping and cycling through Radio Paradise, Trójka, Czwórka and BBC Radio 1. Station metadata: `/api/radio-now` (Paradise), `/api/radio-station?station=bbc1` (also `trojka`, `czworka`). Station logos appear when cover art is unavailable.
- Lab hosts the Streambench, Codebench and Docbench carousel.

- TVPI upstream HLS signatures are short-lived. Prefer maintained TVPI Worker endpoints over short-lived tokenized upstream URLs.
- Weather is a multi-source local ensemble for Kościelec in Chrzanów with air quality, pollen and IMGW warnings.
- Streambench, Code Bench and Doc Bench are local-first browser tools. [Shared privacy and data-handling policy](https://bartek.lol/lab/privacy/); individual LLM guides document service-specific boundaries.
- Tokenowy Mundial AI is maintained as Quarto source in `trvny/trvny` and proxied by TRAVNY from its verified generated HTML.

## Agent access

On browser hosts implementing WebMCP, TRAVNY pages with the shared navigation expose `open_travny_destination`. It only starts navigation to destinations already present in the visible TRAVNY menu and does not accept arbitrary URLs.

Additional read-only tools: `list_travny_destinations` (optional query), and `get_travny_agent_resources` (canonical machine-readable resources). Tools do not fetch cross-origin content. Navigation may open cross-origin menu destinations, but never accepts arbitrary URLs.
